title: ITVX / Digital brand toolkit
slide_intent: Organize reusable ingredients into discoverable groups in a digital reference, because viewers need to recognize the same service across different situations.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen continuity between campaign recognition and service use.
demonstration: A laptop shows a dark toolkit overview with tiles for the ITVX logo, X, typography, overlapping colour circles, layouts and symbols.
practical_value: Organize reusable ingredients into discoverable groups in a digital reference.
